evidence.evidence_text: The performance of large language models (LLMs) has recently improved to the point where models can perform well on many language tasks.
We outline a research program where the behavioral interpretability of LLMs on these tasks is tested via prompting.

We speculate that OpenAI o1's unique advantage over other models may result from the model's chain-of-thought mechanism, which mimics the structure of human reasoning used in complex cognitive tasks, such as linguistic analysis.
